page.layout: One page of text, single column; a decorative headpiece above the title; a decorative ornament below the text. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: AD CLARISSIMVM VIRVM IACOBVM LECTIVM Iurisconsultum, cùm ad illum superiores versus legendos misisset.

p.i: CVr tibi quem primos inter numeramus amicos Carmina postremo nostra legenda damus? Consultum Iuris ne lite moremur iniqua, Lecti, peccatum rusticitate vides.

main_text.head: Responsio Domini Lectij.

p.i: SErus vbi solidam reddit cum fœnore sortem Debitor, ista mihi non male grata mora est: Atqui non sortem, non vllum fœnus amico Debueras vltro pendis vtrunque tamen. Illa voco sortem maiore sonanda cothurno. Fœnus versiculi sunt mihi nempe tui.

page.notes: The title line reads "AD CLARISSIMVM VIRVM IACOBVM LECTIVM" in capitals with a second line in small capitals; the poem's initial letters C and S are large woodcut initials, transcribed with their following words. The verse uses long s as plain s. Ornaments are not text.
